Name: Say Cheese - Villagers Framed Portraits
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
This mod adds unique, collectible portrait furniture for all social vanilla NPCs.

The bulk of this mod uses the setup from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21012][i]Darkroom Portrait Shop[/i][/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AgentLyoko?gameId=1303]Agent Lyoko[/url]. You don't buy mysteriously obtained portraits from the Traveling Merchant (which is always [i]kind of weird[/i]). Instead, now Haley becomes your go-to photographer!

[b]How It Works:[/b][list]
[*]Buy Portrait Tickets from Haley’s shop.
[*]Gift the ticket to any eligible NPC.
[*]That NPC will visit Haley for a photo session off-screen.
[*]After two days, your framed portrait will arrive by mail.
[/list]Check out the [i]Darkroom Portrait Shop[/i] page for more details on how the ticket system works.

[size=6][b]L[/b][/size][size=5][b]atest Update[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Added compatibility to[i] [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018][i]Distant Lands[/i][/url]﻿ and [i][b]Make [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Marlon[/url]﻿/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Gil[/url]﻿/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7102]Gunther[/url]﻿ Real[/b][/i], including Gunther's daughter Cecily!
[/list] ﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/36270/36270-1762518372-1990096939.png[/img]﻿﻿
[color=#ffe599][size=6][b]M[/b][/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599][b]ods Support[/b][/color][/size]
This mod supports these following mods that make villagers friendable, adding custom dialogues and letters for them:[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2569][i]Befriend Marlon and Gunther[/i][/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12667][i]Morris Redeemed[/i][/url].
[/list]This mod will automatically adjust its portraits when the following mods are installed:[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059][i]Diverse Stardew Valley[/i][/url]: works with either the seasonal or non-seasonal version installed. You'd also be able to get the portrait of the best girl Marigold!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23968][i]Bog's Spouse Portraits[/i][/url]: with its Content Patcher version installed, this mod's frame will automatically changes.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265][i]Romanceable Rasmodia[/i][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28316][i]Mayor Louise[/i][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26700][i]Male Caroline Revised[/i][/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29834][i]Piper - A Pierre Rewrite[/i][/url].
[/list][color=#b6d7a8][b]﻿[size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color][list]
[*]Download [i]Villagers Framed Portraits.[/i]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Say Cheese! Framed Portraits for Vanilla NPCs[/font] from your Mods folder.

[color=#a2c4c9][b][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/b][/color][list]
[*]No known compatibility issues that I know of. If you encounter any conflict, please report them!
[/list][color=#9fc5e8][b][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations
[/size][/b][/color]This mod uses i18n. If you want to make a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).[SPOILER]Built-in[list][*]American English 1.4.1
[*]French 1.4.1 (by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Deovos]Deovos[/url]) 
[/list][/SPOILER]

[color=#b4a7d6][b][size=6]C[/size][size=5]redits[/size][/b][/color][list]
[*]All patching logic was built upon [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AgentLyoko?gameId=1303]Agent Lyoko[/url]'s work in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21012][i]Darkroom Portrait Shop[/i][/url].
[*]The main asset of this mod are edited sprites from the vanilla game.
[*]All other asset are edited sprites based on various mods, listed in the "Permissions and credits" dropdown.
[*]Marigold's framed portrait was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url]. 
[*]DSV Additional Characters portraits, as well as the patches pertaining to it, was by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url].
[*]Bog's frame asset was, naturally, by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch?gameId=1303]BogWyytch[/url].
[/list][color=#d5a6bd][size=6][b]S[/b][/size][b][size=5]pecial Thanks[/size][/b][/color][list][*]The Stardew Modmaking Community for providing encouragement and feedback during the development and this mod.
[/list]
